LanguageData.DMSL_AirSupportPager.label: Air Support Pager
LanguageData.DMSL_AirSupportPager.description:
A portable pager device for calling in aerial support.

By spoofing legacy military identification signals, it sends ground strike requests to still-operative ancient aviation facilities without establishing any actual communication link.

Once the signal is accepted, the relevant airbase will dispatch bombers per standard procedure to strike the target area.

Internal protocols cannot be reset, and key components degrade further after each broadcast. This pager can only maintain reliable operation for a limited number of calls before failing completely.
